requirements.value: Applicant must hold current license in another state/territory/province with equivalent requirements, have passed National Board of Examiners in Optometry examination, have 3,120 hours of active practice in 36 months preceding application, and have no disciplinary history
requirements.quote: holds a current license to practice optometry in another state or territory of the United States or in a province of Canada that has licensure requirements that the board determines are equivalent to those established under this chapter; at some time in the past, received a license to practice optometry from another state or territory of the United States or from a province of Canada that required the person to have passed the National Board of Examiners in Optometry examination to qualify for licensure; was engaged in the active licensed clinical practice of optometry in a state or territory of the United States or in a province of Canada for at least 3,120 hours during the 36 months preceding the date of application

exists.quote: There is created the Board of Examiners in Optometry to regulate and control the practice of optometry

title_protection.quote: A person not licensed as an optometrist may not fit, sell, or dispose of or take, receive, or solicit an order for fitting, sale, or disposition of spectacles, eyeglasses, or lenses for the correction or relief of an optical or visual defect of the human eye

scope_protection.quote: A person may not practice, attempt to practice, or offer to practice optometry without first obtaining a license from the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Secured a license through deceit, fraud, or intentional misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: secured a license through deceit, fraud, or intentional misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in deceit, fraud, or intentional misrepresentation in the course of providing professional services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaged in deceit, fraud, or intentional misrepresentation in the course of providing professional services or engaging in professional activities

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertised professional services in a false or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: advertised professional services in a false or misleading manner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a felony or other crime that affects the licensee's ability to practice competently and safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has been convicted of a felony or other crime that affects the licensee's ability to continue to practice competently and safely

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally or negligently engaged in or permitted performance of patient care that does not conform to minimum professional standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: intentionally or negligently engaged in or permitted the performance of patient care by persons under the licensee's supervision that does not conform to minimum professional standards regardless of whether actual injury to the patient occurred

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with the optometry chapter, regulations, or board orders
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failed to comply with this chapter, with a regulation adopted under this chapter, or with an order of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continued to practice after becoming unfit due to professional incompetence, failure to keep informed, addiction, or physical/mental disability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: continued to practice after becoming unfit due to professional incompetence; failure to keep informed of or use current professional theories or practices; addiction or severe dependency on alcohol or other drugs that impairs the licensee's ability to practice safely; physical or mental disability

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in lewd or immoral conduct in connection with delivery of professional services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaged in lewd or immoral conduct in connection with the delivery of professional service to patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to refer a patient to a physician after ascertaining presence of ocular or systemic conditions requiring physician management
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failed to refer a patient to a physician after ascertaining the presence of ocular or systemic conditions requiring management by a physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribed or dispensed an opioid in excess of the maximum dosage authorized
disciplinary_grounds.quote: prescribed or dispensed an opioid in excess of the maximum dosage authorized under AS 08.72.276

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procured, sold, prescribed, or dispensed drugs in violation of law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: procured, sold, prescribed, or dispensed drugs in violation of a law, regardless of whether there has been a criminal action or harm to the patient

definition_quote.value: optometry means the examination, evaluation, diagnosis, treatment, or performance of preventive procedures related to diseases, disorders, or conditions of the human eyes or adjacent and associated structures, consistent with this chapter and regulations adopted by the board
definition_quote.quote: optometry means the examination, evaluation, diagnosis, treatment, or performance of preventive procedures related to diseases, disorders, or conditions of the human eyes or adjacent and associated structures, consistent with this chapter and regulations adopted by the board

methods_authorized.quote: the examination, evaluation, diagnosis, treatment, or performance of preventive procedures related to diseases, disorders, or conditions of the human eyes or adjacent and associated structures

drug_authority.value: A licensee may prescribe and use a pharmaceutical agent, including a controlled substance, in the practice of optometry if the pharmaceutical agent is used in a manner consistent with standards adopted by the board in regulation.
drug_authority.quote: A licensee may prescribe and use a pharmaceutical agent, including a controlled substance, in the practice of optometry if the pharmaceutical agent is used in a manner consistent with standards adopted by the board in regulation.

surgery_prohibited.quote: A licensee may not perform ophthalmic surgery unless the procedure is within the scope of the licensee's education and training from an accredited school of optometry; and authorized by regulations adopted by the board.

surgery_definition.value: ophthalmic surgery means an invasive procedure in which human tissue is cut, ablated, or otherwise penetrated by incision, laser, or other means to treat diseases of the human eye, alter or correct refractive error, or alter or enhance cosmetic appearance
surgery_definition.quote: ophthalmic surgery means an invasive procedure in which human tissue is cut, ablated, or otherwise penetrated by incision, laser, or other means to treat diseases of the human eye, alter or correct refractive error, or alter or enhance cosmetic appearance

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: A licensee may remove superficial foreign bodies from the eye and its appendages.

opioid_prescription_day_limit.quote: an initial prescription for an opioid that exceeds a four-day supply to an adult patient for outpatient use

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: shall have successfully completed the written and practical portions of an examination on ocular pharmacology approved by the board that tests the licensee's or applicant's knowledge of the characteristics, pharmacological effects, indications, contraindications, and emergency care associated with the prescription and use of pharmaceutical agents; a nontopical therapeutic pharmaceutical agent course of at least 23 hours approved by the board or an examination approved by the board on the treatment and management of ocular disease; and an optometry and nontopical therapeutic pharmaceutical agent injection course of at least seven hours approved by the board or equivalent training acceptable to the board

dea_registration_required.quote: require that a licensee who has a federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number register with the controlled substance prescription database

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: a nontopical therapeutic pharmaceutical agent course of at least 23 hours approved by the board

referral_to_physician_required.quote: failed to refer a patient to a physician after ascertaining the presence of ocular or systemic conditions requiring management by a physician

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: authorizing an optometrist licensed under this chapter to delegate routine services of optometry to an agent of the optometrist

telemedicine_authorized.quote: an optometrist licensed under AS 08.72... may provide health care services within the health care provider's authorized scope of practice to a patient in this state through telehealth

impaired_practitioner_program_establishe.quote: the department may contract with public agencies and private professional organizations to provide assistance and treatment to persons licensed by the board who abuse alcohol, other drugs, or other substances

retired_license_status_available.quote: On retiring from practice and on payment of an appropriate one-time fee, a licensee in good standing with the board may apply for the conversion of an active or inactive license to a retired status license.

jurisprudence_exam_required.quote: an examination approved by the board that is designed to test the applicant's knowledge of the laws of Alaska governing the practice of optometry and the regulations adopted under those laws
